identity.promise: readable article-specific engineering explanations with content-led layouts

surface.background: fully opaque white or slightly cool-white canvas
surface.panels: white or very lightly tinted blue-green regions with fine boundaries
surface.finish: quiet front-facing technical layout with deliberate margins

palette_roles.ink: dark charcoal or navy for readable titles and body copy
palette_roles.primary: blue organizes confirmed structure or a named category
palette_roles.secondary: green organizes another category or a supported outcome; not automatically success
palette_roles.attention: orange for a supported emphasis or separate explanatory layer
palette_roles.extension: purple for a supported distinction when needed
palette_roles.failure: red only for an explicitly supported failure or warning
palette_roles.neutral: gray for past workflow secondary paths and supplementary text

line_language.primary: direct readable arrows with visible arrowheads; scale stroke to export size
line_language.secondary: lighter supporting connectors and fine region borders; dashed lines have a declared meaning
line_language.icons: consistent line icons and simple pictograms, with restrained local shaded relief when it clarifies an object

material_and_texture.material: white panels, light tints, technical icons
material_and_texture.shadow: subtle panel separation and local object relief
material_and_texture.forbidden_depth: no page-sized 3D scene, glass-device showcase, chrome, or isometric world

geometry.nucleus: the main subject or reading path; a central hub is not required

depth_and_camera.perspective: local object relief allowed; no global perspective scene
depth_and_camera.lighting: neutral white, restrained object shading, no dramatic glow

typography.title: dark readable title with optional blue-green keyword emphasis
typography.copy: Chinese/English technical sans-serif, labels plus concise explanations
typography.workflow: native generated copy is preserved only after exact validation

density_and_spacing.density: enough verified content to explain the subject, with quiet gaps and subordinate detail
density_and_spacing.reading_order: title then main explanation then supporting details; chosen by content

required_traits: fully opaque white background and lightly tinted information regions
readable title label and explanation hierarchy with blue-green organizing colors
content-led layout with meaningful technical icons and quiet spacing
native generated copy receives exact post-generation validation
forbidden_traits: no transparent canvas or unreadable filler
no page-sized 3D scene glass-device showcase chrome or isometric world
no handwritten paper cyberpunk or decorative mascot
no invented text numbers nodes arrows states metrics or topology

neighbor_boundaries.difference: Style 9 explains technical relationships using labeled regions; Style 1 is sparse editorial illustration.
Style 9 uses front-facing diagrams with restrained local icon relief; Style 4 uses polished spatial product scenes.
Style 9 is front-facing and content-led; Style 5 uses a fixed-isometric world.
Style 9 uses crisp vector-like geometry and sans-serif copy; Style 8 uses warm paper and lively handwritten annotation.
